info.name: Nearby Teacher — Institute Profile APIs
info.description: Dedicated institute six-step profile collection with saved fictional JSON response examples. Set baseUrl and token to a verified institute account with completed registration. Start in Institute Profile — 6 Steps; draft examples are in Draft — Save and Resume. Shared /profiles/me APIs select the institute from the bearer. Step 5 description requires 100 words when supplied. Draft completion tracks successful section saves; publish separately validates required fields. Photo uploads require moderation and do not advance step progress. Existing institute pages with a nonempty slug retain publication compatibility after the rollout migration.

item.name: Institute Profile — 6 Steps
item.description: Use a registered, phone-verified institute bearer in token. The account type is selected from the bearer. Save steps 1–5, then publish step 6. Email and verification/classification badges are read-only. Each successful step saves a draft; GET /profiles/me restores fields and profileDraft.nextStep.

item.name: Draft — Save and Resume
item.description: Example flow: save steps 1–2 first, save step 3 here, restore the draft next day, then continue step 4. Drafts persist in the account across sessions/devices and do not expire. Re-saving earlier steps preserves later progress.
